subject: Emotions
title: Can EQ Be Learned
description: A 60-second lesson on Can EQ Be Learned.

hook.text: IQ barely changes after childhood. But a 50-year-old can be far more emotionally intelligent than at 25.

buildup.text: Unlike IQ, emotional intelligence grows throughout life. The prefrontal cortex—seat of regulation—matures in your 20s.

discovery.text: EQ training programs show measurable gains: better emotion recognition, reduced conflict, improved team performance.

twist.text: But not all programs work. Reading a book about EQ doesn't raise it. Practice, feedback, and reflection do.

climax.text: Life experience is the biggest teacher. Hardship, diverse relationships, and failure build EQ faster than any course.

punchline.text: IQ is what you're born with. EQ is what life teaches you.

quiz.question: What most effectively builds emotional intelligence?
